subject: PO billing windows and SKU-bundling discount — amendment & cadence clarification
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@healthgrid.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-12-01 09:12 PST
Subject: PO template + billing cadence questions for Redwood pilot

Hi Sergio / Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement ran the numbers and we have a few operational constraints we need to lock down before the legal team will sign: 

1) PO on invoice: our AP system requires the PO number on the invoice header (not just in the line items). Can you confirm Redwood can put the PO ID in the invoice header field? Our template is attached.

2) Invoice cadence: for our hospital division we need weekly invoices (each Friday) that roll into a single monthly statement for reconciliation. Is that supported?

3) Net terms: standard is Net 60 for enterprise vendors. However, we have an early-pay program that can shorted to Net 30 with a 2% discount if the vendor can accept weekly invoices and EOM consolidated statements. Is Redwood able to accept Net 30 at a 2% early-pay discount, or do you need Net 60?

4) Packaging / bundling: we intend to combine usage across three SKUs (foundation model calls, embeddings, and a managed cache line) to reach volume thresholds. Will bundled SKU consumption be eligible for a single blended discount slab? If yes, what is the threshold and how will it appear on invoices?

Please see attached PO template. If you can send an operations note and a sample invoice layout that includes the PO header placement we can pass it to our AP team.

Best,
Tara Singh
Senior Procurement Manager — HealthGrid
Attachments: HealthGrid_PO_template.xlsx
From: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@healthgrid.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-01 13:40 PST
Subject: Re: PO template + billing cadence questions for Redwood pilot

Tara —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a couple of follow-ups: 

- PO on header: yes, we can include the PO ID in the invoice header. Our billing system supports a header field and a separate PO line-item column. I attached our internal invoice guidelines for AP (stubbed).

- Weekly invoices into monthly statement: supported. We can emit a weekly invoice each Friday and also produce a consolidated monthly statement with links to each weekly invoice for your reconciliation team.

- Net terms / early-pay: we can operationally accept Net 30 with a 2% early-pay discount under a committed monthly minimum (to offset the cost of weekly invoice processing and early settlement). Can you confirm the minimum monthly committed spend for the hospital division? If you prefer Net 60 we can do that with no discount.

- Bundled SKU discounts: we can offer a blended volume discount across the three SKU categories. Typically the threshold is 1M tokens-equivalent per month for a 5% discount, 5M for 10% and 15M+ for 15% — but we can re-calibrate the bands for enterprise deals. We'll include SKU-level lines and a blended summary line in the consolidated statement so your ledger sees both.

Follow-ups: 
1) Is the PO ID required to be the first line on the header or can it live as a distinct "PO Number" field? Some ERPs insist on the former.
2) Please confirm the committed monthly minimum if you want Net 30 + 2% — that will feed into the SOW amendment.

I'll loop Vanessa and our finance ops team (cc'ed) to draft the sample invoice and the SOW amendment. Attaching: redwood_invoice_guidelines.pdf (stub).

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
Attachments: redwood_invoice_guidelines.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-02 08:05 PST
Subject: Fwd: PO template + billing cadence questions for Redwood pilot — need accounting sign-off on Net30 / weekly invoices

Kimberly —

Forwarding HealthGrid procurement notes. They want weekly invoices + consolidated monthly statement and are asking if we can accept Net 30 at a 2% early-pay discount provided there's a committed monthly minimum. Sergio proposed the blended SKU thresholds (see his reply). Can you confirm whether our billing ops can handle: 

- Weekly invoice issuance to HealthGrid and an EOM consolidated statement
- Option to accept Net 30 with 2% early-pay discount if customer commits to a minimum monthly ARR (suggested floor $75k/month but open to your input)
- PO must appear in invoice header (AP requirement)

If this is operationally doable, can you also prepare the invoice mapping template (GL code mappings) so we can share it with HealthGrid's AP? I copied Vivek since this affects pricing and contract terms.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-03 11:22 PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: PO template + billing cadence questions for Redwood pilot — accounting input

Vanessa / Sergio —

We can support the requested flow with two caveats and an operational compromise: 

1) PO header: confirmed — we will surface the PO number in the invoice header field (ERP-friendly). We'll also replicate it in line items for cross-checking.

2) Weekly invoices + consolidated monthly statement: supported. Our billing system will emit weekly invoices and a single monthly statement that references each weekly invoice ID. For AR purposes we usually post the monthly statement; HealthGrid's AP can continue to remit against each weekly invoice if needed.

3) Net terms: accepting Net 30 across the account increases cashflow pressure. We can offer Net 30 with a 2% early-pay discount but propose a compromise to reduce churn risk: Net 45 standard with an option to convert to Net 30 + 2% if HealthGrid signs a 6-month committed minimum of $60k/month. If a shorter commitment is required by procurement, we can escalate to finance leadership.

4) GL mapping: attached is our invoice_mapping_template.csv (stub). We need HealthGrid to provide their BU codes and GL equivalents so we can map at the invoice generation step. Ideally they return that file within 5 business days.

Action items: 
- Sergio: validate the $60k/month floor with the customer or propose an alternative.
- Vanessa: include the Net 45 / Net 30+2% compromise in the SOW amendment draft and route for legal review.
- Sergio: send a sample weekly invoice layout (we will use header PO placement).

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: invoice_mapping_template.csv
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@healthgrid.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-12-04 16:38 PST
Subject: Re: PO template + billing cadence questions for Redwood pilot — next steps

Sergio / Vanessa / Kimberly —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for being flexible. HealthGrid procurement can accept the Net 45 / Net 30+2% compromise provided the commitment floor is documented in the amendment. We'll sign a 6-month committed minimum at $60k/month and want the SOW amendment to explicitly call out: 

- PO placement: PO number must be present in invoice header and the weekly invoice id must reference the consolidated monthly statement
- Billing cadence: weekly invoices (each Friday) + consolidated EOM statement by the 3rd business day of the following month
- Discounting: blended SKU consumption will be eligible for a single blended discount slab; please include a pricing schedule showing the SKU bands and the blended total; we need visibility into how blended thresholds are calculated (tokens-equivalent definition)
- DocuSign: please send the SOW amendment via DocuSign and include the finalized pricing schedule.

Attached is our executed PO template with the PO ID filled. We'll await the SOW amendment. Please include the invoice mapping template so our AP team can populate GL codes.

Final items for you: sample weekly invoice and consolidated statement, final pricing schedule reflecting SKU bundling (token-equivalent calculation), and the DocuSign link for the amendment.

Best,
Tara Singh
Senior Procurement Manager — HealthGrid
Attachments: HealthGrid_PO_template_filled.xlsx
Links: https://www.docusign.net/contract/abcdef123456
